errors: My first commit chain ran `git checkout -b` on the branch the session already sat on; it failed, so the && chain pushed an unchanged branch before I committed. Re-ran the commit.

doc_friction.issue: Said no session could run sshd; in fact `apt-get download openssh-server libwrap0` plus `dpkg -x` gives a working 9.6p1 sshd -T in the cloud container (needs a `sshd` user and /run/sshd). Now documented in parity/README.md.

notes: Explore idea: differential-test sshd-config-check against the real OpenSSH 9.6p1 binary (sshd -t, sshd -T -C), extracted from Ubuntu's .deb. Seeded generator of config trees; dev seeds 1-600 used for fixing, held-out seeds 20001-22000 recorded after the last fix and replayed by parity.test.mjs. Before: 550 disagreements in 319/2000 configs; after: 0 of 82,598 checks. Main finding: Match all overrides earlier globals for every connection (the engine and its guide called it a return to global scope and reported the overriding line as ignored). Also fixed: nested-Include Match blocks, PermitTunnel case, extra args (per-keyword arity probed against the binary), strtonum/convtime, Match Address host bits. Verification: run_venture_tests.py sshd-config-check ok (59 tests) + site page checks; check_post_links 0 broken; check_llms_txt_links 0 dead. Next: Match Group with real users, IPv6, other OpenSSH versions; same harness for nginx -t / visudo -c checkers.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: set up sshd harness, generator, diagnose 7 parser semantics, fixes, docs

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
